title: Pricing
subtitle: The studio and its companion MCP are free. You bring your own model keys — the marketplace is where money changes hands.
freeNote: No card during beta. The MCP stays free after it: it is offered for adoption, not as a trial to convert.
checkoutDisabled: Nothing to buy on this page
billingNote: No payment gateway is connected, so nothing here can charge you. When marketplace sales switch on, the platform earns a share of each one — never a fee for using the studio.

mcpFree.title: The MCP is free
mcpFree.body: Connect DeeWaanAI from Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen Code or Kimi and run your pipelines from the app you already use. No plan, no seat, no meter.

byok.title: Bring your own model keys
byok.body: Add your own LLM provider keys in Settings and pay those providers directly. We never hold a wallet on your behalf.

noPerRun.title: No per-run fees
noPerRun.body: We never meter a run: each provider call is billed by your own provider, at their price.

commission.title: The marketplace earns a commission
commission.body: Money moves when a pipeline sells. A share of that sale is the platform's; the rest is the creator's. Your own work is never the thing being billed.

platform.name: DeeWaanAI
platform.tagline: Studio, evaluations and companion MCP — everything, one account
platform.feature2: Up to 3 LLM providers per pipeline
platform.feature4: Companion MCP: run pipelines from Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen Code & Kimi

marketplace.title: Certified pipelines, sold as a copy
marketplace.body: Buying a marketplace listing hands you the workflow itself — edited into your own account, run on your own keys. Every listing is published with its full test record: the exact judging prompts, every score and every failure, signed so you can check who issued it on your own machine rather than taking our word for it.
